name: Damage Stock Report
query:
SELECT 
    b.item_code AS "Item Code",
    i.item_name AS "Item Name",
    b.warehouse AS "Warehouse",
    b.actual_qty AS "Damaged Quantity"
FROM 
    `tabBin` b
JOIN 
    `tabItem` i ON b.item_code = i.item_code
WHERE 
    b.warehouse = 'Damaged Stocks - SC'  -- Filter by warehouse for "Damaged Stocks - SC"
    AND b.actual_qty > 0  -- Ensure only items with quantity in stock are shown
ORDER BY 
    b.actual_qty DESC;
